assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished square human character portrait asset for Yumetan, a Japanese dream journal app. Original refined contemporary anime illustration, cinematic soft painterly shading, delicate clean linework, expressive natural eyes, tasteful fabric folds, restrained fine gold celestial accents. Consistent half-body portrait from head through hips with entire hair and hands comfortably inside frame and at least 10% margin. Deep midnight indigo #17142b background with subtle atmospheric group-color glow, tiny sparse stars, moonlit rim light. Focus on clear readable silhouette and emotional storytelling for a small mobile card. Not chibi, not plush, not photorealistic, not a costume or armored fantasy character. No text, numbers, type labels, logos, watermark, panel border, collage or extra people. Character 01 REN / chase type. Reference the TOP LEFT panel of the attached sheet only for the design idea: an adult young man with tousled short black hair, charcoal oversized hoodie, turned three-quarter away looking back over his shoulder, hand slightly raised mid-step. Eyes alert, mildly tense but courageous rather than terrified. A few soft dusty-rose trails behind him suggest a pursuing dream, no pursuer visible. Rose group accent. Keep both hands anatomically natural and no extreme foreshortening. Transform the flat gray reference into a polished night-themed app illustration.
